programs.title: ACC Football Road Trip
programs.desc: A 17-school preseason road trip to preview each team's upcoming season and include exclusive interviews with head coaches and student-athletes, showcasing unique aspects of those 17 football campuses.

programs.title: ACC Huddle
programs.desc: ACC Huddle, ACCN's signature football show, airs on Saturday mornings this fall. Host Kelsey Riggs and analysts Eric Mac Lain, EJ Manuel, Mark Richt, and Eddie Royal go on the road to preview the weekend's slate of ACC football games.

programs.title: Authentic ACC
programs.desc: In this edition of the series produced by North Carolina Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 UNC Tar Heels.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Orange host the Tar Heels for some Friday night frights at the JMA Wireless Dome. Both teams have been spooked of late, losing four in a row. North Carolina has haunted Syracuse across the past two meetings, outscoring the Orange 71-13.
